Apple’s AI Strategy Faces Scrutiny
Apple Inc.
CEO John Ternus defended the company’s approach to AI after criticism that it had fallen behind rivals.
"I really like where we’re at," he said.

Apple And Samsung Avoid The Worst Of The Chip Downturn
Counterpoint Research said global smartphone SoC shipments fell 21% year over year in the third quarter of 2026, with midrange and entry-level devices hit hardest.
Rising memory costs and longer replacement cycles are the pressures, but Apple remained better positioned than several chip suppliers.

CEO

mocked Apple after a fully configured Mac Studio appeared on its website at $29,799.

Apple’s Stock Breaks From The Broader Tech Trade
Apple’s three-month correlation with the Nasdaq 100 fell to negative 0.12, the first negative reading in data going back to the early 1980s, according to The Kobeissi Letter.
Apple shares gained 9.7% while the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.2% over the period.
